# OpenRussian dictionary data

The local morphological dictionary is derived from the `Badestrand/russian-dictionary` repository, which publishes data from OpenRussian.org.

- Source: https://github.com/Badestrand/russian-dictionary
- Website: https://en.openrussian.org
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0)
- License text: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The imported CSV backup contains English and German translations. This application displays an independently curated Portuguese glossary for course vocabulary and English as a fallback. The source project notes that its repository CSVs may be older than the live OpenRussian database.
